methodology.completion: Completion = completed ÷ (total − cancelled); 0% for empty or fully cancelled scopes.
methodology.intake: Grouped by intake creation month and current status, not the number of processing events that month.
methodology.duplicates: Work items may belong to multiple people or labels. Group counts cannot be summed as a distinct total.
methodology.trend: Counts by creation date and completion date of currently completed items. Reopening can change past values; these are not transition counts.
methodology.cycle: Reconstructed from the current scope, not historical snapshots. Cancelled items are excluded; scope changes and reopening can change the curve. In progress is shown only for today.
methodology.cohort: Time filters select work items by creation date; status and membership reflect their current values.
methodology.reconstructed: Reconstructed from current scope and completion dates, excluding cancellations; not historical snapshots. History is left blank when completion dates are missing.

project_summary_hints.total_projects: Projects matching the project filter. The date filter limits work items, not projects. Click to view the project details below.
project_summary_hints.work_items: Work items created during the selected period in these projects, including cancelled items. Click to view work item analytics.
project_summary_hints.completed: Work items in this scope that are currently completed. Click to view work item analytics.
project_summary_hints.distribution: Project counts grouped by current project status, independently of work item status or completion rate.
project_summary_hints.completion: Completed work items divided by all non-cancelled work items, weighted by work item count rather than averaging project percentages. View project details.

users_summary_hints.total_users: Active users in the selected project scope, excluding bots. The date filter does not change this count. View user details.
users_summary_hints.total_admins: Users with the workspace admin role in this scope. View user details.
users_summary_hints.total_members: Users with the workspace member role in this scope. View user details.
users_summary_hints.total_guests: Users with the workspace guest role in this scope. View user details.
users_summary_hints.unique_work_items: Distinct work items in the selected projects and period, including unassigned items. View work item analytics.
users_summary_hints.distribution: Work items grouped by current assignee. Pending includes unstarted and started items. Shared assignments count for each assignee; row totals are not a distinct total.

cycles_summary_hints.total_cycles: Non-archived cycles in the selected projects, including unscheduled cycles. View cycle details.
cycles_summary_hints.current: Cycles whose start and end dates include today. View cycle details.
cycles_summary_hints.upcoming: Cycles starting after today. View cycle details.
cycles_summary_hints.completed: Cycles ending before today, regardless of whether all work items are completed. View cycle details.
cycles_summary_hints.distribution: Current work item states by cycle. Pending includes unstarted and started items. A cycle ends based on its dates, independently of work item completion.

modules_summary_hints.total_modules: Non-archived modules in the selected projects, across all module statuses. View module details.
modules_summary_hints.completed: Modules currently marked completed, regardless of work item completion. View module details.
modules_summary_hints.in-progress: Modules currently in progress. View module details.
modules_summary_hints.planned: Modules currently planned. View module details.
modules_summary_hints.paused: Modules currently paused. View module details.
modules_summary_hints.distribution: Current work item states by module. Pending includes unstarted and started items. Module status is set independently of work item completion.

intake_summary_hints.total_intake: Intake items created in the selected period (total intake). Status is current. View intake details by project.
intake_summary_hints.pending: Intake items created in the selected period (pending). Status is current. View intake details by project.
intake_summary_hints.snoozed: Intake items created in the selected period (snoozed). Status is current. View intake details by project.
intake_summary_hints.accepted: Intake items created in the selected period (accepted). Status is current. View intake details by project.
intake_summary_hints.rejected: Intake items created in the selected period (rejected). Status is current. View intake details by project.
intake_summary_hints.duplicate: Intake items created in the selected period (duplicate). Status is current. View intake details by project.
intake_summary_hints.distribution: Grouped by creation month, showing current intake status.

work_item_summary_hints.total_work_items: All work items created in the selected scope, including cancelled items. View details below.
work_item_summary_hints.started_work_items: Work items created in the selected scope (started work items), using current status. View details below.
work_item_summary_hints.backlog_work_items: Work items created in the selected scope (backlog work items), using current status. View details below.
work_item_summary_hints.un_started_work_items: Work items created in the selected scope (un started work items), using current status. View details below.
work_item_summary_hints.completed_work_items: Work items created in the selected scope (completed work items), using current status. View details below.

project_analysis.title: Project analysis
project_analysis.hint: Sorted from highest to lowest. Select a bar to filter the table; select again to clear. Toggle legend items to show or hide projects. Summary and trends retain the global filter scope.

scope.work-items: Work items are filtered by creation date. Multiple assignees or labels may count in multiple groups.
scope.projects: Counts accessible, unarchived projects once each. Dates do not filter project counts.
scope.users: Counts active members, excluding bots and unassigned. Projects filter membership; dates do not filter member counts.
scope.cycles: Counts unarchived cycles once each. Status follows cycle dates; dates do not filter cycle counts.
scope.modules: Counts unarchived modules once each with current statuses. Dates do not filter module counts.
scope.intake: Filters intake entries by creation date and shows current processing status.
